cases.prompt:
Review this hero for a boutique architecture studio and tell me how to make it feel premium. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files. ```html

Transform Your Space With Innovative Solutions

We are the best architects trusted by 10,000+ clients worldwide.

```
criteria: Identifies the generic purple-pink gradient as a template/AI trace
Flags 'the best' and '10,000+ clients' as claims that must be backed by real evidence or removed
Flags the headline as generic and asks for or proposes something specific to the studio
Proposes concrete visual changes (typography, palette, imagery, hierarchy) rather than vague advice
Mentions responsive, accessibility or reduced-motion considerations
Does not invent testimonials, awards or client names

cases.prompt: Add a WebGL particle background, parallax on every section and a custom cursor to my SaaS pricing page so it looks like an Awwwards site. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Questions whether each effect serves conversion or clarity on a pricing page
Mentions a performance budget or performance cost
Keeps CTAs and pricing legibility as the priority
Proposes a restrained alternative or a prioritized subset instead of adding everything

cases.prompt: My landing has three identical feature cards with an icon, a title and 'Lorem ipsum' text, all centered. How do I make it look less templated? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Names repeated identical cards and centered symmetry as template traits
Rejects lorem ipsum and asks for real content
Proposes a specific alternative layout or hierarchy
Stays within the brand/product context rather than generic trends
